It happened just last week on a Zoom interview for this marketing assistant job. Zoom is already the worst, right? Because you have that weird audio delay and you never know when someone is actually done speaking. Plus, I had to use my roommate's laptop because mine completely died. It's a MacBook, and the screen just went black. I took it to the Genius Bar, and the guy—he was wearing this really cool vintage band tee, I think it was Fleetwood Mac—he told me the logic board was fried. It's the most unflattering angle ever.

But she wasn't even asking about that! She was trying to ask about analytics software. It was so embarrassing. I could see her face just kind of freeze, and then there was that horrible awkward silence. I didn't get a call back for that one.
